integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone finite verifier; finite enumeration not substituted for universal reasoning; historical-priority and independent-validation limitations stated.
scientific_limitations: Two-sided literal binary subshift; exact language and entropy claims only. Qualitative entropy separation already established on four letters. No claim of novelty for the general phenomenon, no claim of a new maximal-measure theorem; residual risk of an unindexed equivalent binary presentation.
title: A binary sparse forbidden presentation with exact Fibonacci complexity and maximal antidictionary entropy
